Spalten: Reihe und Bandnummer (Pflicht): Columns (the headers are German, as in the export): Reihe (series) and Bandnummer (volume number) are required, plus Reihenverlag (series publisher), Verlag (publisher, only if the volume differs), Autor (author), Typ (type; “Reihe” = row for the series only), Status (Vorhanden = owned, Fehlt = missing, Vorbestellt = pre-ordered, Erscheint bald = coming soon, Bestellt = ordered; “Gelesen” = Vorhanden + read), ISBN, Preis (price), Zielpreis (target price), the priority column (0–3), Erscheinungsdatum (release date), Erscheinungsjahr (release year), Kaufdatum (purchase date), Zustand (condition), Seiten (pages), Notizen (notes), Reihen-Wunsch (series wish, 0–3), Reihenstatus (series status), Sammelstatus (collecting status: aktiv = active, pausiert = paused, abgebrochen = dropped; empty = active), the total-volumes column, Alternativtitel (alternative title), Sprache (language: a code such as de, en, ja or the name), Region (two letters, e.g. US), the currency column (three letters, e.g. EUR), Werk (work: the same value links editions of one series), Tags, Manga-Passion-ID, Reihen-Cover (series cover), Reihen-Banner (series banner), Beschreibung (description), Band-Cover (volume cover), Bilder (images, separated by |), MP-Band-ID (MP volume ID), Bandsprache (volume language; empty = the series language), the read-by column and Besitzer (owner) (usernames, separated by comma or |; owner only with status Vorhanden; unknown names are ignored, with no match you become the owner). Only admins can enter other people as owner or reader; everyone else only themselves. A row without a volume number or with type “Reihe” only creates the series or sets its wish. Existing volumes (series + type + number) are never changed. The easiest way: export first and use the file as a template. In Excel, format the ISBN and volume number columns as text. At most 20,000 rows and 10 MB per file. Image files and prices per owner are not part of the CSV – use the ZIP backup for those. Cover or series values that are too long (e.g. old data: covers) are skipped with a notice; the volume is still created.
